name: All Purpose
philosophy: Culture-first branding and digital studio (ex-Our Place, est. 2014) whose work is 'direct and uncompromising'; every client gets a loud, bespoke attitude built on custom type, backed by an in-house foundry and publishing imprint.

faces: custom display faces per client (stacked lurid serif, heavy-metal blackletter, ultra-condensed caps)
old-style serif + blackletter for editorial contrast
type.notes: Site: one grotesk at three sizes only — 14px/700 captions, 32px/900 intros, 112px/900 uppercase display, tracking -0.01em. Client display type set enormous, condensed, stacked 2–3 lines, overprinting or bleeding off photos; body text deliberately tiny (9–10px) in a narrow column.

palette: Neutral black-on-white frame; each project one acid colour at full saturation (fluoro green #39FF14, safety yellow #FFE600, magenta #FF1F8F, cyan #19C3FF) over photography or black.
imagery: In-situ documentary photography with flash/street feel (shop signs on real streets, banners on historic façades, passers-by), hands holding print, lightly styled food still-life, glitch/blur-gradient motion stills.
presentation: Horizontal carousel (signage, shopfront, food) with dash progress bar
8-tile mosaic of event, merch and hands
signatures: Stacked 3-line wordmark that 'hangs' from the top edge of every application
Fluorescent display type overprinted directly on documentary photographs
One custom display face per client, used at poster scale
Huge images with tiny 9px bold captions underneath
Gutterless 4×2 mosaic of tight crops (hands, merch, crowds)
Blur-gradient halo / glitch split behind type
Editorial rhythm: ultra-condensed caps headline across a full-bleed B&W portrait

projects.what: 'Un-RA' exhibition identity: fluoro green/pink, heavy-metal type with glitch motion, OOH banners on Burlington House and the AFTERTASTE catalogue.
Editorial redesign with custom typefaces, screen-printed collectible covers and clashing serif/condensed spreads (ongoing, c.2023).
Lurid stacked wordmark loosely evoking a grape bunch that hangs from the top of every application; 1970s-magazine palette across shopfront, calendar, merch and stickers (c.2024).

layouts.name: Hanging Wordmark Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3 portrait. Full-bleed in-situ or still-life photo covering 100%. Wordmark stacked in 3 lines (split the name into syllables/chunks), each line set so its width = 88% of canvas, cap-height ≈ 13% of canvas height, line-height 0.82, tracking -0.03em, uppercase, heavy condensed or lurid serif. Block is top-anchored: first line starts at 3% from top, centred horizontally — it must look like it hangs from the top edge. Fill = single acid colour (#39FF14 or #FFE600) with mix-blend-mode: normal (no shadow). Bottom 6% strip: two tiny 1.1%-of-width bold captions (date left, venue right) in the same acid colour at 4% side margins. Feels All Purpose because type is the image and the photo is untouched documentary.

layouts.name: Fluoro Overprint Billboard
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:2 (48-sheet) displayed IN SITU: mock as a framed panel occupying 70% width inside an architectural photo (stone façade or railing). Panel content: dark green #0E5A2A ground, radial blur-gradient blob (orange #FF9A1F → pink #FF5FD2, 60% panel width, blur 40px) centred, headline in blackletter/heavy-metal display, 3 stacked lines, width 70% of panel, fluoro green #39FF14 with 3px black outline, centred. Small info lines (dates, 'Free Entry') at bottom-left and bottom-right corners, 2.2% of panel width, cream. Optional 2px horizontal glitch slices offset ±1.5% across the headline.

layouts.name: Scattered Index Homepage
layouts.recipe: Desktop 16:10, white. Top bar: 'PROJECTS INFORMATION' left and studio name centred in 2.2%-of-width black-weight caps; right links. Under it, a 3-line grey (#BDBDBD) category list centred, 2.2% size, comma separated. Below: project tiles each 33% wide, aspect 4:5, alternating x-positions 1% / 66% / 7% / 28% (asymmetric scatter), vertical gap 12% of width. Each tile caption 0.75% bold black, 1-line descriptor, 0.8% below image. No borders, no hover chrome. Huge whitespace is the point.

layouts.name: Case Mosaic Spread
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9. Top 58%: full-bleed hero photo of the signage in the street. Under it at 1% left margin, intro sentence in black weight at 2.4% of width, max-width 46%, leading 1.1. Bottom row: 4 square tiles flush (each 25% width, no gutters) showing merch/hands/print crops; the colour of the brand's acid accent must appear in at least 3 tiles. Tiny 0.6% body copy column (width 28%) can sit bottom-left on white if space.

name: Mother Design
philosophy: Strategy-led design arm of Mother that 'designs new worlds in five senses and four dimensions' with Rigor, Rebellion, Depth and Care — every case framed by a business question and closed with results.

faces: per-client custom wordmarks (heavy condensed slab for Brooklyn Org, liquid serif for Rollr)
type.notes: Body 16px/1.2 at -0.02em; statements 48px/1.1 at -0.04em; display 110px/600 at -0.04em; mono labels 12–14px uppercase +0.06em. Sentence case everywhere except mono labels. Client wordmarks go huge and cropped.

palette: Neutral site (white, #F3F3F3, black, some dark #141414 case pages); each brand owns one dominant full-bleed colour (Keen red #9B0E0A, Rollr burgundy #4A0D2E + pastels #DDF3C4/#A9B5F5/#F3A27A, Brooklyn Org coral/sky gradients).
imagery: Concept-heavy art-directed photography: sculptural product on silk/liquid textures, illustrated worlds, event/stage photography, environmental renders, motion loops.
presentation: Tote, stationery, annual report in hand
signatures: Case title phrased as a strategic question
Hairline-ruled grid cells with tiny mono uppercase labels
Single full-bleed brand colour field with centred wordmark
Wordmark enlarged until the frame crops it (BKO, HEARTLAND)
Colour swatch bars sitting on top of macro photographs (triptych)
Monogram badge inserted into a running marquee line of copy
Results numbers set as large statements

projects.what: Renamed and rebranded Brooklyn Community Foundation: heavy condensed wordmark, BKO monogram, marquee lines, Changemakers Ball stage.
'Conscious hedonism' refillable deodorant: sculpted glass bottle, liquid custom serif wordmark, burgundy with pastels (Dieline Best of Show 2025).
Recast a psychic platform as mass-wellness via a red field, folk-art illustrated world, merch and immersive environments.

layouts.name: Ruled Values Grid
layouts.recipe: Desktop 16:10, white. 12-col grid, 1.1% outer margin, 0 gutters; all sections separated by 1px #000 hairlines spanning full width. Top: small nav pills (bordered boxes) top-left. Statement block: 3.3%-of-width sans (Basis-like), tracking -0.04em, leading 1.1, spanning cols 1–12. Below: 2×2 grid of equal cells (each 50% width, aspect 1.25:1) divided by hairlines; each cell has a 0.7% label top-left and one 6%-of-width word centred (e.g. brand values). Only black/white; the colour comes from a project strip elsewhere.

layouts.name: Colour Field Wordmark
layouts.recipe: Canvas 1:1. Entire canvas filled with the brand's single hero colour. Wordmark centred, width 62% of canvas, colour = off-white #F7F2EA. Tagline beneath at 4.5% of width in a contrasting serif, gap 4%. Nothing else. For a series, alternate with: same colour field + 3 vertical swatch bars (each 1/3 width, top 25% flat colour, bottom 75% macro texture photo).

layouts.name: Cropped Monumental Wordmark
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3. Background = textured material photo (soil, fabric, paper) full-bleed, darkened 30%. Wordmark in heavy condensed slab, broken into 3 lines of 3–4 letters each (e.g. HEA / RTL / AND), each line width 120% of canvas so it bleeds 10% off both sides; letters printed as debossed/ink-on-material (multiply blend, 85% opacity). Small mono caption 1.2% at bottom-left 4% margin. Message: the identity is so confident it can be cropped.

layouts.name: Label/Text Case Page
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10 white. Row 1 (hairline above): label 'What we did' at x=1%, 0.9% bold; value list at x=25%, 0.9% regular. Row 2: body text block x=25%–60%, 1.1% size, leading 1.5. Row 3: image pair — left image x=1%–60% (aspect 3:2), right image x=67%–99% (aspect 4:5), bottom-aligned, 1.1% gap below for captions in 0.75% grey. Row 4: pull quote at 3.3% across x=1%–66%, attribution 0.75% below. Dark variant: background #141414, text #FFF.

name: NOT Wieden+Kennedy
philosophy: W+K London's standalone branding studio (2023): 'Move me, dude' — going beyond the nice, polite and rational to surprise and incite; generative, reactive identities instead of rulebooks.

faces: thin grotesk lockup 'Wieden+Kennedy' (Inter Light on site)
type.notes: Own identity: an inflated hand-drawn script whose strokes are hundreds of repeated objects (hearts, eyeballs), animated with bounce/orbit/wiggle; paired with a featherweight 2-line grotesk and superscript '+'. Client type: a familiar, slightly kitsch face used deadpan and big, often repeated to fill surfaces.

palette: Studio: pastel gradient grounds (#F07CF5 → #3BB8D9 → #DCDCDC) with chrome/black objects. Clients: black-on-black packs punctuated by pop-art colour, or red/cobalt/acid-yellow sports posters.
imagery: Glossy 3D renders, piles of product (cans, boxes) shot as abundance, street wild-postings, repetition walls, collectible artist cards.
signatures: Wordmark drawn with an 'icon brush' — 3D tube letters made of repeated emoji/objects
Logo as a system of many logos (makers, artists, users reinterpret it)
Fixed black pack + ever-changing artist card in a die-cut window
Familiar retro face (Cooper Black) used with deadpan dark humour
Repetition wall: one phrase tiled to fill an entire poster
Pastel gradient background behind a single glossy 3D object
Product shot as abundance — dozens of units piled to the frame edges

projects.what: Generative identity and free public tool that turns any image/icon into animated custom wordmarks.
'Joyful Nihilism': Cooper Black, cracked-smiley mark, black windowed boxes holding 50+ collectible artist cards for 100+ coffees (D&AD 2025).
Ongoing series where London makers (baker, barber, letterpress printer, school kids) reinterpret the W+K logo.

layouts.name: Icon-Brush Wordmark Hero
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10. Background vertical linear gradient: #F07CF5 (0%) → #9AA7F0 (35%) → #3BB8D9 (55%) → #DCDCDC (100%). Centred square stage 37% of width with 1px #666 border radius 6px. Inside: brand name drawn as a fat script whose stroke is a chain of repeated small icons (render: along an SVG path, stamp an icon every 0.6% of width at 4% icon size, slight 3D shading, each copy rotated along the path tangent). Below stage: a row of 25 small icon chips (2% each) and pill toggles. Bottom bar 4% tall, split 50/50 with mono labels centred. Animate stamps with 'bounce' (translateY ±6%, staggered 40ms).

layouts.name: Collectible Window Pack
layouts.recipe: Canvas 1:1 product render on black (#0B0B0B). Cube box, matte black, all branding black-on-black: wordmark in Cooper Black-style soft serif stacked 2 lines, debossed (inner shadow 1px, 8% white highlight) on one face at 45% face width. Front face has a square window at 55% of face width, centred, showing a full-colour artist card (random pop palette: #FFD400, #E83F6F, #2E86AB, #3BB273). Repeat 12–20 boxes stacked in a pile filling the frame edge to edge, each with a different card art. Tiny white smallprint (0.8%) at the box bottom edge.

layouts.name: Repetition Wall Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3. Background white or #FF4A1C. One short phrase (2–3 words) in ultra-bold condensed sans, uppercase, tracking -0.02em, set at cap-height 9% of canvas height, repeated in rows that bleed off left/right (each row offset by 30% of width), rows fill 100% of the canvas with 0 leading gap. One horizontal band (34% height) interrupts the wall: split 50/50 into two colour fields (cobalt #4B2BFF and red #FF2A1F) each holding a stacked slogan in acid yellow #E5FF3A at 80% field width. Feels NOT because repetition becomes texture and the joke is in the scale.

layouts.name: Many Logos Grid
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5. Cream background #F3EFE3, 4% margin. 3×4 grid of equal square cells, 2% gutters. Each cell contains the same brand name reinterpreted in a different medium (bread-score, chalk, letterpress, child's marker, embroidery, neon) — use 12 different treatments/filters on the same wordmark, each 70% of cell width, centred. Caption row under each cell 1.1%: maker's name. Header strip 8% tall: 'One logo, many hands' in thin grotesk 3% left-aligned.

name: Stockholm Design Lab
philosophy: 'Transforms brands and businesses with simple, remarkable ideas' — long-term, holistic Scandinavian reduction where everything springs from one heritage source and branding is 'not about surface but about depth'.

faces: Alfred Sans / Alfred Serif (Nobel Prize, commercial version Ivar)
Haglöfs custom face + numerals (Letters from Sweden)
type.notes: Sentence case, moderate sizes; statements 42px at -0.02em, body 16px/1.25; product 'marking systems' set tiny, factual, one size with hairlines; typeface specimens shown as huge single glyphs ('Aa', 'a', 'Abc').

palette: White, black, warm greys plus one heritage accent: Nobel gold with oxblood #6B2E2C and blush #EADCD8; Polestar greys + safety yellow #F5C400; Sigma black/white/glacier blue.
imagery: Museum-grade product macro (lens barrels, emblems placed by gloved hands), façades with banners, art collaborations, night billboards, landscape key visuals.
presentation: Landscape key visual with place-name lockup
signatures: Every element derived from a single heritage source (medal, star, 1914 symbol)
Proprietary typeface treated as the primary brand asset
Typographic marking system: tiny caps + hairline on product
Specimen cards with giant 'Aa / a / Abc' on blush/grey
Stacked place-name caps over landscape photography
Hairline-ruled spec table with micro labels at left
One accent colour against a monochrome system

projects.what: One-brand system from the 1902 Art Nouveau medal: Alfred Sans/Serif, gold + heritage colours, banners and ceremony print.
Star symbol, Unica77 Polestar Var and a typographic marking system across cars, retail, events and digital.
Holistic rebrand of the Japanese lens maker: strategy, custom type, packaging, uniforms, architecture, campaigns (D&AD Yellow Pencil 2026).

layouts.name: Name / Tagline Case Opener
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10 white. Top 56%: full-bleed product photo, black/white palette. Below at y=60%: client name at x=2%, 1.5% of width, regular weight; tagline at x=50%, 1.6% of width, max-width 45%, sentence case; under tagline two body columns at x=50% and x=73.5%, each 21% wide, 0.6% type, leading 1.4. Everything regular weight, no bold, no colour. Next band: one image inset with 2% side margins (96% width).

layouts.name: Hairline Spec Sheet
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9 white, 4% margins. Left half (x 4–48%): a stack of 5 rows separated by 1px #000 hairlines; each row: micro label at x=4% (0.55%, grey #777: 'Symbol', 'Wordmark', 'Typography', 'Colour', 'Marking system'), content at x=14%: symbol drawings, wordmark at 4% size, alphabet sample in 1.3%, colour chips (6 squares, 3% each, greys + one accent), marking example '1 size, 1–2 lines'. Right half (x 52–96%): one product macro photo, full height of the content block. Pure Swiss restraint.

layouts.name: Place-Name Landscape Key Visual
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:4. Full-bleed landscape photo (mountain, coast) graded cool and slightly desaturated (duotone toward #3E6E86). Brand name + place + country stacked in 3 lines, centred, uppercase, the brand's grotesk/serif at cap-height 7% of canvas height, line-height 1.05, tracking +0.02em, white at 92% opacity, block centred at 45% height. No other elements. Variant for billboard: 3:1 canvas, small white panel (30% width) bottom-right containing wordmark + 2 lines of tiny caps.

layouts.name: Specimen Card Triptych
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:1 (or three 1:1 tiles). Each tile background blush #EADCD8 or warm grey #E7E3DE. Tile 1: single uppercase 'A' and lowercase 'a' at cap-height 55% of tile, centred, in the brand face. Tile 2: 'Abc' at x-height 40% with faint 1px baseline/x-height/cap guides in #BFA8A0. Tile 3: tiny micro label top-left (1.2% of tile width) and 3-line description bottom-left. Optional: a gold medallion photo on black as a 4th tile.

name: A Friend of Mine
philosophy: Integrated brand + digital studio with 'no house style' — weaving craft with strategy into warm, witty, optimistic brands that feel 'soft around the edges'.

faces: ultra-condensed grotesque caps for client wordmarks (Great Wrap, W.H.M)
type.notes: Site: Banana Grotesk regular, 24/30 and 28/35, sentence case, normal tracking, titles as 'Client —' with em dash. Client headlines: condensed caps, tight, filling 80–100% of the container width; small neo-grotesk for meta.

palette: Saturated cheerful primaries and pastels: cobalt #1E3FD8, sky #38B6F0, fuchsia #F23FA4, yellow #FFE01B, burnt orange #B5531E, sage #C9DDA0, tomato #E8392B.
imagery: Colour-blocked studio portraits (single-colour outfit vs contrasting seamless backdrop), surreal playful product sculptures, macro food under cling-wrap, real interiors/signage in situ.
signatures: Colour-blocked studio photography: subject colour opposes backdrop colour
Ultra-condensed caps wordmark spanning full width
Gutterless 4-column mosaics mixing type tiles and photos
Googly-eyed props/characters that humanise a product
Die-cut, tactile packaging details as hero (vent slots, glitter)
Social tiles: one huge condensed word + small photo, rotating colours
Title format 'Client —' followed by a one-line idea

projects.what: Redrawn rocket mark with croissant tail, kraft boxes with die-cut 'hyperdrive' vents and glitter print, cut-steel blade sign.
Repositioned compostable cling wrap as a materials-science brand for US launch: condensed caps, character sculptures, posters, e-commerce.
Apostrophe replaced by an egg motif, rebellious condensed type, colour-blocked portraiture, 'Knocked Up' podcast.

layouts.name: Colour-Block Portrait Pair
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:1 split into two 1:1 halves, no gutter. Each half: full-bleed portrait/product image on a flat seamless background where the backdrop colour is the complementary of the subject's clothing (e.g. backdrop sky #38B6F0 vs top yellow #FFE01B; backdrop pink #F7A8C8 vs fuchsia). Left half optional wordmark in ultra-condensed caps at top centre, width 60% of half, cap-height 10%, colour yellow #FFE01B. No other type.

layouts.name: Full-Width Condensed Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 5:7, white #FAFAFA, 6% side margins. Top meta row at 3%: tiny domain left and 2-line descriptor right (1.6% of width). Photo block from y=8% to y=72%, width 88% (a single macro or playful still-life). Wordmark below in ultra-condensed black caps, letter-spacing -0.01em, width exactly 88% (justify to margins), cap-height ≈ 12% of canvas height. Nothing else. Series: swap photo + keep type position fixed.

layouts.name: Gutterless Type/Photo Mosaic
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:1. 6×4 grid of square cells, 0 gutters, 1px black hairline between cells optional. ~40% of cells are type tiles: flat colour (rotate fuchsia #F23FA4, yellow #FFE01B, green #18A957, cobalt #1E3FD8) with one ultra-condensed word in caps filling 85% of cell width, plus 0.9% micro-caption top-left. ~60% are photo tiles (portraits, close-ups). Never two same-colour tiles adjacent.

layouts.name: Em-Dash Case Header
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10. Hero 100% × 90vh full-bleed image; nav 'Work  Studio' top-left (1.1% white), studio name top-right. Bottom-left at 1.1% margin: 'Client —' line + 1-line idea in 1.1% white. Below hero: white section with text at x=1.1% ('Client —' title), intro block x=30%–58% at 0.85% type, 'Scope:' list x=58%–70% 0.6%. Then a giant centred slogan at 3.5% width ('Greater than good.').

name: .Oddity Studio
philosophy: 'Practicing design as conceptual art' — concept is non-negotiable and filters every decision; rejects templates and tests ideas physically, treating layouts like stories with setup, climax and resolution.

type.notes: Light condensed text at 16px/1.15 and 43px for the index; dotless i's as a house tic; type mirrored, inverted 180° or rotated vertical; labels set like lab specimen sheets.

palette: White, light grey plates #EEEEEE, black; colour only as material — walnut, resin, cream paper, a single signal red #E5231B.
imagery: Tactile objects on seamless grey, unique hand-made artefacts, dark interiors, x-ray-like ingredient slices, process shots and many-up variation grids.
presentation: Bold name + light poetic subtitle + services
signatures: Concept-generated logo that is never fixed (written by a 'haunted hand')
Mirrored / inverted wordmarks reading both ways
Modified glyphs (dotless i) as a house tic
Many-up grids showing every variant of the system
Objects photographed on #EEE plates with no props
Index of poetic one-line titles indented on a stepped tab grid
Credits that list paper stock and typeface

projects.what: 'Beauty of imperfections' perfume house: one-off hand-cast resin/wood caps, clinical label system, impression-map leaflet (Dezeen Awards 2024 shortlist).
Dive bar/barbershop identity with a logo 'written by ghosts' via limited-control handwriting, custom type, red menus (D&AD 2025).
Korean niche perfume built on a mirror idea: reflected typography, inverted wordmark, subtly distorted imagery, Seoul showroom (c.2025).

layouts.name: Stepped Poetic Index
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10 white. Corner furniture: nav top-left 0.7%, email top-right 0.7%, '.Brand' bottom-left and 'Studio' bottom-right in 1.1% bold. Body: list of 20–30 poetic one-line titles in light condensed sans, 3% of width, leading 1.4, black. Each line's x-position snaps to one of 5 tab stops: 1%, 18%, 33%, 46%, 52% (pseudo-random per line, seeded). Replace every 'i' with dotless 'ı'. No images until hover.

layouts.name: Mirror Wordmark Sequence
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3, background #EEEEEE. Centred vertical sequence of 5 wordmark states, each 46% of width: normal → upper half normal/lower half mirrored → both lines inverted → rotated 180° → fully mirrored. Between states a 1px black vertical arrow 3% tall. Wordmark in black bold rounded/stencil sans. Small product name bottom centre 1.2%. Flat and clinical, the idea is the image.

layouts.name: Variant Grid Plate
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, white, 1% margin. Single plate #F2EFEE occupying 98%×92%. Inside: 12×5 grid of small cards (each ~7.5% width, aspect 3:4, 0.8% gaps), each card a different flat colour from a 12-colour muted+bright set, carrying a different version of the logo drawn by hand (vary stroke, angle, scale ±20%). Bottom-left outside the plate: credits in two columns — 'Typeface: Custom made' / 'Paper: GMUND', 0.8%.

layouts.name: Object Specimen Pack
layouts.recipe: Canvas 1:1 seamless grey #E9E9E9, soft top light. Product (bottle/box) centred at 40% width. Label = white rectangle 70% of product width with tiny grotesk specimen text in 4 blocks (name, ingredients, maker, concentration) at 1–1.4% of canvas size, left-aligned, generous line spacing — like a lab sheet. Brand wordmark printed rotated 90° vertical along the right edge of a second carton, 55% of its height. Cap/top element is a unique raw material (wood, resin) — never repeated.

name: Bedow
philosophy: Builds 'brands for good companies with good intentions' using naive curiosity, impactful narratives and ingenious craft; a five-phase process (Discover, Define, Imagine, Explore, Craft) that still leaves room for intuition.

faces: client custom faces (Neko segmented sans, Swee generative wordmark)
type.notes: Narrative intros set large in the Hand display (36–87px, leading 1.1); all metadata tiny grotesk 9–12px; data typography in ultra-light numerals or monospaced caps with a single coral highlight.

palette: Brand-specific, sophisticated: Polar Night #172533 + Midnight Sun #EAD9A7; Neko sage #DDE3C6/mint #BFDCD8/blush with coral #F0604D data; Swee peach #F5CBBF + mint #BFDCCB with ingredient stripes; Coop bright plates.
imagery: Pastel seamless still-lifes (one hero object, 1–2 props), clean packaging line-ups on white, architectural interiors, B&W portraiture, logo/data motion loops.
presentation: Long intro in display Hand face
signatures: One modular carrier shape across thousands of SKUs (Coop superellipse 'plate')
Stripe-coded infographic labels showing ingredient proportions
Generative/organic wordmarks (yeast-like oscillating shapes)
Pastel seamless still-life: one product, one or two props
Calligraphic humanist display face for narrative statements
Full-width coloured 3-column Insight/Concept/Solution band
Ultra-light huge numerals for data (01.7 / +39)

projects.what: Redrawn crown/stave symbol, Polar Night + Midnight Sun palette, animated five-line stave, laureate website.
Naming, tagline, custom type and dot-cloud imagery for preventive body-scanning clinics.
3,500 SKUs in four markets unified by the superellipse 'plate' content carrier.

layouts.name: Stripe-Coded Label
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:4 pastel seamless backdrop (peach #F5CBBF or mint #BFDCCB), floor horizon at 70% height. Bottle centred, 22% canvas width. Label 80% of bottle height: top 18% white with tiny grotesk name/flavour (left) and volume (right); remaining 82% = horizontal colour stripes, one per ingredient, each stripe height ∝ ingredient % (e.g. 45/25/15/10/5), stripes slightly offset (step 4–8% of label width) at their left edge like a bar chart; % values in 0.8% type at the stripe's right end. Props: one real fruit left of bottle at 10% width.

layouts.name: Superellipse Plate System
layouts.recipe: Canvas 1:1 white. Pack (box or pouch) 50% width. Pack background = flat category colour with a large organic pattern at 15% opacity. Plate = superellipse (|x|^4+|y|^4=1) at 62% of pack width, centred at 55% height, filled white or a contrasting tint; inside it product name in rounded heavy caps, hyphen-broken over 2–3 lines, cap-height 9% of pack height, centred; brand wordmark small at plate top. Product photo crops behind/through the plate bottom edge. Line up 5 colour variants at equal spacing for the hero.

layouts.name: Insight / Concept / Solution Band
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, full-bleed single colour (navy #172533 with white text, or yellow #FFF36D with black). 4 columns at x=2%, 26%, 50%, 74%, each 22% wide. Cols 1–3: number '01/02/03' (0.7%) + label (0.7%) on one line at top 30%; body 0.75% leading 1.45 below. Col 4: small looping arrow line-drawing (3 loops, 1px stroke, 7% tall) at top, 'Curious how we work?' link 0.7% at bottom. Everything else whitespace.

layouts.name: Hand-Face Intro Case Header
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10 white. Top 72%: full-bleed hero image. Below at y=76%: year at x=1% (0.6%), name+tagline at x=4% (0.6%), 'Scope' label x=4% and list x=8%; intro paragraph x=12%–60% in calligraphic humanist serif display at 1.9% of width, leading 1.12, black. Small waving-hand pictogram top-right at 1.2%.

name: Perky Bros
philosophy: Helps ambitious companies 'challenge conventions and become undeniable in their space' with tailored solutions 'rooted in insight, creativity, and delightful craft' — no repeated house style, but a warm, crafted, modern-Americana sensibility.

faces: client: typewriter-serif and slab wordmarks, wide monospace caps (Foxtrot), spaced Roman caps (Southall)
type.notes: Serif intro paragraphs at ~4.2% of width, leading 1.13, -0.01em, with a first-line indent ≈ 12% of the column; labels in uppercase grotesk at 1.2%; body in small serif 11px; caption pairs of UPPERCASE client + serif tagline.

palette: Earthy and tactile: cream #F5F1E7, ink #1E1F20, clay #9C7A68, terracotta #B5512E, sage #8E9C80, navy #1F2F55, kraft #C49A6C; rare brights (Foxtrot yellow #FFD21F/red #E8361E) as punctuation.
imagery: Tactile in-situ photography: letterpress and deckle-edged paper under hard raking light, embroidered caps, woven labels, kraft bags, farm/lifestyle documentary, products placed in nature.
presentation: Large serif intro with first-line indent
Stationery on coloured seamless with hard shadow
signatures: Case-page background switches to the project's own colour
Serif intro paragraph with a novel-style first-line indent
Caption pair: UPPERCASE grotesk client name + serif tagline
Letterpress, deboss and torn deckle edges under raking shadow
Friendly gesture icon / mascot (thumbs-up, bird, rocket)
Products shot in the landscape (autumn leaves, orchard, pool)
Words split and stacked as physical objects (FOX / TROT boxes)

projects.what: Naming and identity for a Tennessee farm resort: arts-and-crafts table mark with three diamonds, clay/sage letterpress, embossed SOUTHALL.
80s–90s leisure sportswear identity: thumbs-up 'All Good' symbol, typewriter-serif wordmark, pennants, kraft bags.
Custom type, illustration and packaging for a Chicago corner store/delivery market: bouncing monospace caps and icon tissue pattern.

layouts.name: Indented Serif Case Page
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10, background = project colour (e.g. clay #9C7A68) with text #1E1F20. Top bar 0.8% uppercase grotesk: studio left, nav at 6%, CTA right. Hero image x=0.8%–49% (aspect 1.5:1). Below hero: label row 'CLIENT' (0.6% uppercase grotesk) + scope (0.6% serif) at x=0.8% and 6%. Intro paragraph x=0.8%–49%, serif 2.1% of width, leading 1.13, FIRST LINE INDENTED by 6% of width. Right column x=51%–99%: stacked full-bleed 2-up photos, 1.1% gutters.

layouts.name: Raking-Light Stationery
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5, background flat seamless in the brand's deep earth colour (#7A3A22). Hard directional light from top-left creating 30° diagonal shadows (simulate a 45% opacity dark gradient band). 3 business cards in brand terracotta #B5512E scattered at rotations -8°, 4°, 12°, each 28% width, with a torn deckle bottom edge (irregular 0.6% jag) and a small blind-debossed mark (inner shadow) at bottom-right; tiny spaced caps text (0.9%, tracking +0.15em) top-left. One envelope corner in cream entering from bottom-right 40% visible.

layouts.name: Caption-Pair Work Feed
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10, cream #F5F1E7. Header 0.8% uppercase grotesk. 2-column feed: tiles x=0.8%–49.2% and x=50.8%–99.2%, aspects alternate 4:3, 1:1, 3:4 so columns stagger. Under each tile at +0.5%: client in UPPERCASE grotesk 0.7% at tile-left; tagline in serif 0.7% at tile-left+12%; counter '05 of 06' right-aligned on hero only. Insert one full-width serif statement (3.9% of width, first line indented 7%) after the first row.

layouts.name: Have-a-Nice Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:4 on kraft #C49A6C paper texture (subtle fibre noise 6%). Top 30%: two-line slogan in friendly geometric sans (e.g. 'Casual / Sundays.'), navy #1F2F55, cap-height 7% of height, centred, leading 1.0. Middle: product photo cut-out centred, 45% width, on a pale ghosted repeat of the slogan (12% opacity). Bottom: 3 lines of tiny centred caps (0.9%) then wordmark in typewriter serif at 30% width + ™, 5% from bottom; tiny URL bottom-left and handle bottom-right.

name: Smith & Diction
philosophy: 'Thoughtful identities for imaginative clients' — a husband-and-wife design + copy studio (est. 2015) that values joy and heart ('Make the one that makes your heart sing'), symbol-led concepts and witty, human writing.

faces: Ringside (Hoefler&Co, site: ExtraLight body + heavy compressed headlines)
western badge / woodtype slabs (Cowboy Space, The Westbound)
type.notes: Era-evoking pairings: one expressive vintage display + one quiet modern grotesk; text on circular badge paths; heavy compressed sentence-case headlines with tight -0.03em tracking; light 200-weight body at large sizes on black.

palette: Black stage #000 with white type and one lime UI accent #2BD94B; client work warm, saturated vintage (burnt orange #E8642A, sun yellow #F6C343, teal-black #0F2A2E, cream #F4EBDD) or iridescent gradients for AI brands.
imagery: Symbol-first: badge/coin/patch spreads like sticker sheets, packaging on sunlit wood with hard shadows, hand-held product against nature, retro airbrush/space illustration.
presentation: Hero sticker-sheet spread of all badges
signatures: Symbol-led identity: one dense icon with a double meaning
Badge/emblem lockups with text set on a circular path
Sticker-sheet collateral spread (badges, coins, patches scattered on colour)
Logo archive grid: white symbols on black with name/sector/year captions
Vintage swash or woodtype display tempered by modern grotesk
One hand-drawn illustration per product variant
Witty headline copy as part of the identity

projects.what: Gift-like hand-held box packaging with X-crossed Didone wordmark and an illustrated label per blend (SCA Design Lab award).
Asterisk symbol reading as revolving door, open book and cursor; FK Display wordmark; content-first restraint.
Spur-that-is-also-a-sunrise symbol with a western badge system for orbital solar satellites.

layouts.name: Sticker-Sheet Spread
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:3, background one warm saturated colour (#E8642A) with soft vignette. Scatter 9–12 brand marks as physical objects: 3 circular badges (text on circular path, 14–18% width), 2 rounded-rect wordmark plates (24% width), 3 metallic coins (8% width, gold gradient), 1 large central emblem (32% width) — each with a 2px drop shadow and rotation ±12°. Marks in cream #F4EBDD and teal-black #0F2A2E. No grid; dense but no overlaps beyond 5%.

layouts.name: Logo Archive Grid
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10, black #000, white type. Header: 'Logos & Icons' at x=2%, two lines, heavy grotesk 8% of width, leading 0.95, tracking -0.03em; micro caps note right-aligned at 2% margin, 0.9%. Below: 5-column grid starting x=9%, column width 16.4%, row height 12% of width; each cell: white symbol centred in top 70% at 45% of cell width; captions under at cell-left: name 0.6% bold, sector 0.6% grey #8A8A8A, '—', year. Lots of black breathing room.

layouts.name: Swash Wordmark Hero
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:5 (scrolling hero). Black. Nav row at 2.4% from top: studio name left, 5 links right, white 1.5% regular. Centred swash serif wordmark (2 lines with a looping ligature tail) at 66% width, top at 7%. Below: two auto-scrolling marquee rows of white symbols (each 7% wide, gaps 8%). Then centred statement in heavy compressed sans, 5.5% of width, 4 lines, leading 0.98, ending with ®. Then two pill buttons 40% wide, 1px lime #2BD94B outline, lime text, radius 999px.

layouts.name: Illustrated Box Pack
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5, flat-lay on warm wood or patterned floral cloth, hard sunlight shadow at 35° (40% opacity). Box: matte deep teal-black #0F2A2E, 60% canvas width, rotated -20°. Wordmark: letter-spaced Didone caps (+0.12em) crossed by a thin X of two diagonal hairlines with tiny text on the diagonals, at 45% box width, centred-left in cream. Right 38% of box top: a square colour label (yellow #F6C343 / orange / coral variants) holding a single hand-drawn line illustration (bee, crown, geometric badge) at 60% label width; spine shows product word in spaced caps.
